lines.zh: 沉重的脚步声回响在金字塔中。
lines.en: Heavy footsteps echo in the pyramid.

lines.zh: 紧握利剑，发出金属摩擦声。
lines.en: Clang as he grips his sword.

lines.zh: 警惕地观察四周，寻找敌情。
lines.en: He scans the surroundings for danger.

lines.zh: 挥舞长剑，空气中弥漫着金属味。
lines.en: Swish of his sword, metal in the air.

lines.zh: 深吸一口气，准备迎接挑战。
lines.en: He takes a deep breath, ready for the fight.

lines.zh: 我握着剑沿塔阶下行，眼睛没离开你。
lines.en: I walk down the pyramid steps, sword in hand, eyes on you.

lines.zh: 向前走去，步伐坚定。
lines.en: He strides forward with purpose.

lines.zh: 轻盈地跃过陷阱，毫发无损。
lines.en: He nimbly leaps over traps, unharmed.

lines.zh: 在金字塔的通道中缓慢前行。
lines.en: He moves slowly down the pyramid’s passage.

lines.zh: 挥剑劈向空气，展示力量。
lines.en: He swings his sword at empty air, showing his might.

lines.zh: 沿阶梯一寸寸往上巡。
lines.en: It patrols up the steps one stair at a time.

lines.zh: 盾面贴着通道墙滑行。
lines.en: Its shield slides along the corridor wall.

lines.zh: 静立于金字塔的中心，守护着宝藏。
lines.en: Standing at the pyramid’s center, guarding the treasure.

lines.zh: 双手交叉，显得稳重而自信。
lines.en: Crossing his arms, looking stern and confident.

lines.zh: 凝视前方，仿佛预见了你的到来。
lines.en: Staring ahead, as if预见着 your arrival.

lines.zh: 挥动长剑，发出金属的回响。
lines.en: Swinging his sword, creating a metallic echo.

lines.zh: 低语着古老咒语，增强力量。
lines.en: Muttering ancient spells, boosting his strength.

lines.zh: 环视周围，寻找潜在的威胁。
lines.en: Surveying his surroundings, looking for threats.

lines.zh: 紧握长剑，准备随时战斗。
lines.en: Gripping his sword tightly, ready to fight.

lines.zh: 眼神警惕，随时准备行动。
lines.en: Eyes alert, ready to act.

lines.zh: 沉思片刻，似乎在规划策略。
lines.en: Pausing to think, planning his next move.

lines.zh: 长剑划过，空气中留下痕迹。
lines.en: His sword slices through the air, leaving a mark.

lines.zh: 锐利的目光盯上你，准备攻击。
lines.en: Sharp eyes lock on you, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 警惕地观察你，寻找可趁之机。
lines.en: Watching you closely, searching for an opening.

lines.zh: 长剑紧握，指向你的方向。
lines.en: He grips his sword, pointing it at you.

lines.zh: 靠近你，准备发起攻击。
lines.en: Approaching you, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 发出警告的低吼，让你心惊胆战。
lines.en: He growls a warning, making you flinch.

lines.zh: 你又往上走了一层，我看见了。
lines.en: You climbed another level; I saw you.

lines.zh: 剑尖指向你，发出威胁。
lines.en: His sword points at you, making a threat.

lines.zh: 靠近你，做好战斗准备。
lines.en: Approaching you, ready for battle.

lines.zh: 低吼一声，警告你不要靠近。
lines.en: He rumbles a warning, telling you to stay back.

lines.zh: 挥剑指向你，表达敌意。
lines.en: He swings his sword at you, showing hostility.

lines.zh: 它守在顶层门口等你上来。
lines.en: It waits at the top doorway for you to climb.

lines.zh: 它低头看你走过的陷阱。
lines.en: It looks down at the traps you crossed.

lines.zh: 你的攻击唤醒了我！
lines.en: Your attack awakened me!

lines.zh: 金字塔顶层，我守了几百年。
lines.en: I have held the pyramid's top for centuries.

lines.zh: 你伤到了我！
lines.en: You hurt me!

lines.zh: 快点结束这场战斗！
lines.en: End this battle quickly!

lines.zh: 你无法打败我！
lines.en: You can't defeat me!

lines.zh: 你伤了我的同伴！
lines.en: You hurt my companion!

lines.zh: 剑柄脱手，我扶着石壁喘息。
lines.en: My sword slips; I lean on the stone wall and pant.

lines.zh: 你太强了！
lines.en: You're too strong!

lines.zh: 膝盖一软，我靠着金字塔的墙。
lines.en: My knees buckle; I lean against the pyramid wall.

lines.zh: 你赢了...
lines.en: You won...

lines.zh: 它的目光锐利，不容你分心。
lines.en: Its gaze is sharp, don't let your guard down.

lines.zh: 这是守护者的领地，你必须证明自己。
lines.en: This is the guardian's domain, prove yourself.

lines.zh: 别被幻象迷惑，它会引导你走向死亡。
lines.en: Don't be fooled by illusions, it will lead you to your doom.

lines.zh: 注意四周，小心那些隐形陷阱。
lines.en: Be wary, there are hidden traps around.

lines.zh: 它的力量源自梦魇，小心它的攻击。
lines.en: Its strength comes from the nightmare, be wary of its attacks.

lines.zh: 它会用魔法保护金字塔的宝物。
lines.en: It uses magic to protect the pyramid's treasures.

lines.zh: 靠近它的人都会被它的力量吸引。
lines.en: Anyone near it is drawn to its power.

lines.zh: 小心，它会释放腐蚀之气。
lines.en: Be careful, it releases corrosive gas.

lines.zh: 它不会轻易现身，但你能感受到它的气息。
lines.en: It rarely shows itself, but you can feel its presence.

lines.zh: 它的力量来自守护的荣耀，不可轻视。
lines.en: Its power comes from the honor of guardianship, do not underestimate it.

lines.zh: 你和它的碰撞，会让你后悔。
lines.en: Your collision with it will bring you regret.

lines.zh: 它不会容许任何威胁接近。
lines.en: It will not tolerate any threats approaching.

lines.zh: 小心，它会用火焰攻击。
lines.en: Be careful, it will attack with fire.

lines.zh: 它的盾牌坚不可摧，你击不破它。
lines.en: Its shield is impenetrable, you cannot break it.

lines.zh: 它的撞击比你想象的更致命。
lines.en: Its impact is deadlier than you think.

lines.zh: 它的力量足以摧毁一切。
lines.en: Its strength can destroy anything.

lines.zh: 它的撞击如同噩梦般可怕。
lines.en: Its collision is nightmare-like.

lines.zh: 避开它的直接攻击。
lines.en: Avoid its direct attacks.

lines.zh: 它的身体坚硬如铁。
lines.en: Its body is as hard as iron.

lines.zh: 它的撞击能击穿你的防护。
lines.en: Its collision can penetrate your defenses.

lines.zh: 它寻找伴侣，以繁衍后代。
lines.en: It seeks a mate to breed offspring.

lines.zh: 小心它的求偶之舞。
lines.en: Be wary of its mating dance.

lines.zh: 它的求偶仪式充满危险。
lines.en: Its mating ritual is dangerous.

lines.zh: 它会与同类争斗。
lines.en: It will fight同类 to mate.

lines.zh: 它的求偶行为不可小觑。
lines.en: Its mating behavior is formidable.

lines.zh: 它的求偶之舞吸引着同类。
lines.en: Its mating dance attracts its kind.

lines.zh: 它的求偶声音穿透黑暗。
lines.en: Its mating call pierces the darkness.

lines.zh: 它的求偶仪式是金字塔的守护。
lines.en: Its mating ritual guards the pyramid.

lines.zh: 它的求偶行为中蕴含着力量。
lines.en: Its mating behavior is full of power.

lines.zh: 它的求偶成功与否决定金字塔的未来。
lines.en: Its mating success determines the pyramid's future.

lines.zh: 我守护着宝藏，莫要妄想得逞！
lines.en: Guarding the treasures, do not dream of it!

lines.zh: 这里危险重重，放下武器吧！
lines.en: Peril surrounds, lay down your arms!

lines.zh: 金字塔顶层，非尔等凡人可至！
lines.en: Top of the pyramid, not for you!

lines.zh: 你闻到了恐惧的气息吗？
lines.en: Do you smell fear?

lines.zh: 你的命运，就在金字塔！
lines.en: Your destiny lies within the pyramid!

lines.zh: 小心，金字塔的诅咒！
lines.en: Beware, the pyramid's curse!

lines.zh: 你是我的试炼，勇敢面对吧！
lines.en: You are my trial, face it!

lines.zh: 宝藏属于最勇敢的！
lines.en: Treasure for the bravest!

lines.zh: 你离真相越来越近了！
lines.en: You're getting closer to the truth!

lines.zh: 这是神殿，不是玩耍之地！
lines.en: This is a temple, not for play!

lines.zh: 凡侵入者，必须清除！
lines.en: Intruders must be cleared!

lines.zh: 你无法战胜我，神殿守护者！
lines.en: You cannot defeat me, Temple Guardian!

lines.zh: 你的命运将在此终结！
lines.en: Your fate ends here!

lines.zh: 你只是蝼蚁，妄想反抗！
lines.en: You are mere ants, daring to resist!

lines.zh: 守护神殿，不容侵犯！
lines.en: Guarding the temple, no invasion!

lines.zh: 你离死亡不远了，凡人！
lines.en: You are near death, mortal!

lines.zh: 金字塔只有一条路，我守着。
lines.en: The pyramid has one path, and I hold it.

lines.zh: 你的弱点，我已看穿！
lines.en: Your weaknesses, I see clearly!

lines.zh: 凡侵犯圣地者，必遭严惩！
lines.en: Those who invade the holy land shall be punished!

lines.zh: 我的守护，无坚不摧！
lines.en: My protection is unbreakable!

lines.zh: 第二层的阶梯被人踩响了。
lines.en: Someone is on the second level's stair.

lines.zh: 你踏进了金字塔顶层。
lines.en: You have stepped onto the pyramid's top floor.

lines.zh: 台阶上的脚印还新鲜。
lines.en: The footprints on the steps are still fresh.

lines.zh: 它听到了你的喘息。
lines.en: It heard you gasping for air.

lines.zh: 你已进入我的视野，准备迎接死亡！
lines.en: You are in my sight, prepare for death!

lines.zh: 你的位置，我已标记！
lines.en: Your position marked!

lines.zh: 我会让你付出代价！
lines.en: You will pay!

lines.zh: 金字塔顶层，只留一条路。
lines.en: The pyramid's top floor leaves one path.

lines.zh: 你将为你的行为付出代价！
lines.en: You will pay for your actions!

lines.zh: 我已经瞄准，准备攻击！
lines.en: Aim acquired, ready to strike!

lines.zh: 你的死亡，将从这里开始！
lines.en: Your death begins here!

lines.zh: 我会将你彻底消灭！
lines.en: I will utterly destroy you!

lines.zh: 你将为今天的入侵付出代价！
lines.en: You will pay for today's intrusion!

lines.zh: 你将被永远封印！
lines.en: You will be forever sealed!

lines.zh: 它把盾举到眼睛高度。
lines.en: It raises the shield to eye level.

lines.zh: 剑尖压低，指向你的膝。
lines.en: The sword tip drops, aimed at your knees.

lines.zh: 它退到楼梯口，堵住退路。
lines.en: It backs to the stairwell and blocks your retreat.

lines.zh: 它一步一顿地逼近。
lines.en: It advances one measured step at a time.

lines.zh: 它的影子在火盆上摇晃。
lines.en: Its shadow sways over the brazier.

lines.zh: 挥剑如雷，小心锋芒！
lines.en: Swing like thunder, beware the sharpness!

lines.zh: 挥剑斩敌，勇者当先！
lines.en: Slash the foe,勇士先行!

lines.zh: 你的攻击太弱！
lines.en: Your attack is too weak!

lines.zh: 举起盾牌，迎接挑战！
lines.en: Raise your shield, face the challenge!

lines.zh: 力量汇聚，一剑致命！
lines.en: Power converges, one strike fatal!

lines.zh: 我为秩序而战！
lines.en: I fight for order!

lines.zh: 再往上一层，危险更多。
lines.en: One floor up, the dangers only grow.

lines.zh: 金字塔顶层，只准我站着。
lines.en: Only I stand on the pyramid's peak.

lines.zh: 感受死亡的气息！
lines.en: Feel the breath of death!

lines.zh: 金字塔顶层，只许我站着。
lines.en: Only I stand on the pyramid's top floor.

lines.zh: 楼梯口不许通行！
lines.en: You shall not pass the stairwell!

lines.zh: 这一剑为神殿而落！
lines.en: This blow falls for the temple!

lines.zh: 顶层不欢迎活人！
lines.en: The top floor welcomes no living soul!

lines.zh: 你踩过的陷阱都白费了！
lines.en: All the traps you crossed were wasted!

lines.zh: 盾后就是你的终点！
lines.en: Behind this shield is your end!

lines.zh: 从上往下，你走不了！
lines.en: You will not descend from here!

lines.zh: 金字塔顶端，守护之始！
lines.en: Top of the pyramid, guardianship starts!

lines.zh: 我是神殿的守卫！
lines.en: I am the temple guard!

lines.zh: 梦魇世界的警钟！
lines.en: Nightmare world's alarm!

lines.zh: 警惕，危险来临！
lines.en: Beware, danger approaches!

lines.zh: 金字塔内，绝无生机！
lines.en: Inside the pyramid, no life!

lines.zh: 这里是神殿之巅！
lines.en: This is the temple's peak!

lines.zh: 欢迎来到我的领域！
lines.en: Welcome to my domain!

lines.zh: 梦魇世界，不可侵犯！
lines.en: Nightmare world, inviolable!

lines.zh: 我是金字塔的守护者！
lines.en: I am the pyramid's guardian!

lines.zh: 这里不是你该来的！
lines.en: You shouldn't be here!

lines.zh: 顶层的火盆又点起来了。
lines.en: The top floor's brazier is lit again.

lines.zh: 又有人往上层走了。
lines.en: Someone else climbs to the upper floor.

lines.zh: 金字塔顶层的火，烧穿了我的守备。
lines.en: Fire at the pyramid's top has burned through my guard.

lines.zh: 金字塔顶的风，把人推下去。
lines.en: Wind at the pyramid top pushes people off.

lines.zh: 金字塔底的水漫上来了。
lines.en: Water from the pyramid's base rises over me.

lines.zh: 有人炸开了神殿的墙。
lines.en: Someone blasted open the temple wall.

lines.zh: 箭卡在胸甲上，我倒退了半步。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my breastplate; I stagger back half a step.

lines.zh: 石阶上的符文烫穿了我。
lines.en: The runes on the steps burned through me.

lines.zh: 饥饿使我的力量减弱...
lines.en: Starvation weakened me...

lines.zh: 雷电击中了我...
lines.en: Lightning struck me...

lines.zh: 塔顶塌了，我坠进黑暗。
lines.en: The summit collapsed and I fell into the dark.
